observations.code_quote: The worksheet library offers editable question starters for daily events, daily distinct people, events ranked by distinct people, and page views by referring domain. Each uses the last seven days of event data and opens as an unsaved worksheet; press **Run** to query it. The page-view starter requires captured `$pageview` events with `$referring_domain` for a useful breakdown. The worksheet library also suggests up to three certified sources. Metric suggestions were removed in [#120111](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/120111); SQL metrics remain accessible through **Explore in BI** in the catalog. Source context keeps certification visible and groups descriptions and relationship review status under **Catalog details**, collapsed by default to leave room for fields. Neutral catalog buttons show an external-link icon to indicate that they leave the worksheet. Relationship proposals open the catalog with the source prefilled; they become usable joins only after approval. Optional catalog suggestions do not prevent opening the worksheet library when the catalog is unavailable. Browser Back returns from a starter to the worksheet library; confirming discarded edits does not replace that history entry with an empty worksheet.
